heading_en: Buckets, Risk Weights and Correlations for Delta Risk of Credit Spread Risk on Securitization Products (Non-CTP)
summary_ja: 証券化商品(非CTP)に係る信用スプレッド・リスクのデルタ・リスクについて、バケット分類、リスク・ウェイト、相関係数及びマーケット・リスク相当額の合計方法を定める。
summary_en: Sets the bucket classification, risk weights, correlation coefficients and the aggregation of the market risk equivalent amount for delta risk of credit spread risk on securitization products (non-CTP).
paragraphs: For delta risk of credit spread risk on securitization products (non-CTP), risk factors shall be classified as provided below. (i) They shall be classified into twenty-five buckets according to the categories of credit quality listed in the middle column and sector listed in the lower column of the following table. {{T:p373t0}}. (ii) The classification of sectors in the preceding item shall be based on classifications generally used in the market and shall satisfy all of the following requirements. (a) Each tranche shall be classified into exactly one bucket number. (b) Where a tranche cannot be classified into an individual sector, it shall be classified into bucket number 25.

The risk weights used for delta risk of credit spread risk on securitization products (non-CTP) shall be as prescribed in the lower column of the following table according to the category of bucket number listed in the upper column of the same table (meaning the bucket number classified under the preceding paragraph; the same applies below in this Article). {{T:p374t1}}

The correlation coefficient (ρ_{kl}) between risk factors used for delta risk of credit spread risk on securitization products (non-CTP) shall, where the bucket falls under any of bucket numbers 1 through 24, be calculated by the following formula. {{F:p375i0}}

In the formula of the preceding paragraph, the values of {{F:p375i1}}, {{F:p375i2}} and {{F:p375i3}} shall be as prescribed in each of the following items according to the following categories of correlation coefficient. (i) {{F:p375i4}}: the value prescribed in (a) or (b) below according to the following cases. (a) Where the name of sensitivity k and the name of sensitivity l are the same and they are regarded as tranches of the same securitization product: 100%. (b) In cases other than (a): 40%. (ii) {{F:p375i5}}: the value prescribed in (a) or (b) below according to the following cases. (a) Where the tenor of sensitivity k and the tenor of sensitivity l are the same: 100%. (b) In cases other than (a): 80%. (iii) {{F:p375i6}}: the value prescribed in (a) or (b) below according to the following cases. (a) Where sensitivity k and sensitivity l relate to the same curve: 100%. (b) In cases other than (a): 99.9%.

Notwithstanding Article 260-2, paragraph (4), where risk-weighted sensitivities are aggregated within the sector falling under bucket number 25 for delta risk of credit spread risk on securitization products (non-CTP), the aggregation shall be calculated by the following formula. {{F:p375i7}}
The correlation coefficient (γ_{bc}) between buckets (excluding bucket number 25) used for delta risk of credit spread risk on securitization products (non-CTP) shall be 0%.

The market risk equivalent amount for securitization products (non-CTP) shall be the sum of the risk-weighted sensitivity of bucket number 25 calculated by the formula in paragraph (5) and the aggregate of the market risk equivalent amounts of the bucket numbers other than bucket number 25, calculated by the formula in Article 260-2, paragraph (5) using the correlation coefficient (γ_{bc}) prescribed in the preceding paragraph.
